contentHtml:
Every business starts as an idea. It turns into a brand the moment it has a look, a feel, and a first impression that sticks. I help bring that to life with proper design for logos, pamphlets and business cards. No design jargon, just something that looks the part and is genuinely yours, ready to print or post online. I work with businesses across Stretton and Brisbane.

Designed with you, refined until it is right

I work closely with you rather than handing over a template and hoping. Starting from scratch or refreshing something you already have, I take you through it step by step, and I keep revising until you are happy with it. Unlimited revisions, so you are not stuck with a "near enough" version.

What I design

  • Logo design. Original concepts built around your business, in a modern, clean or traditional style, delivered as transparent PNG, high-res JPG, PDF and vector (AI and EPS) so they work on your website, signage, print and merchandise.
  • Pamphlet and flyer design. Single-sided or folded, laid out to be easy to read and on-brand, good for a price list, a service rundown or an event, supplied print-ready and easy to share online.
  • Business card design. Horizontal or vertical layouts with your details, logo and a QR code if you want one, ready to send to the printer.

Files you actually own

You get full usage rights and the source files, so the artwork is yours to use however you like down the track, not locked to me. Most design jobs turn around in three to five days. If your website needs the same attention, see my website design service.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
